description: This file defines a set of React components for a custom select dropdown UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons, with utility functions for styling.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main select component wrapping Radix UI's Root component.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component for the clickable trigger to open the dropdown.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown content, including viewport and scroll buttons.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Component for labeling sections within the select.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Component representing an individual selectable item.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Component for separating groups of items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll up within the dropdown.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll down within the dropdown.
